keyFindings.description: The lock guard fails open on a failed lock read, with no retry, so an API error lets a dead run TERM or remove in another run's copy. Read through kube_read (one retry) and, when it still fails, act on nothing and say so; drop the fail-open sentence in pg_disk_watch.

liveTransport reads only config.dashboard; this PR's own runs from 4e33cee7 to 9701e56b recorded the transport only in live.transport (every step sse on 9b92ac14), so re-rendering them labels SSE steps live and drops the column, and README:1426 is false for them.
The branch conflicts with main again (#2422 reflowed packages/envoy/AGENTS.md); merge main.
sha256_of and joined_sha256 defined twice after the merge (72-76 and 336-340).
Three long streams (2800, 2809, 2944) bypass the guarded helpers because those are fixed to kube's 300 s limit; give the helper a duration and route them through it.
use_run skips the lock comparison two ways (any-run and the _* prefix); have the daemons pass any-run and drop the prefix clause.
